construction: Choose full-row-rank W spanning the ordinary LEFT annihilator of col(B), so WB=0 and rank W=k-rank B. No conjugate-transpose is inserted into this complex-linear coordinate equation.

Conversely the displayed full matrix factorization sends ker R0 into itself. Coefficientwise factorization proves the affine statement; determinant degree is the dimension bound. All canonical ideal bases of this kernel span the same whole N. No rank is inferred from a selected subset unless both inclusions and dimensions are certified.
